audit.why: 51.98% over 1337 games fits EVEN 5.5/10. The lane is a standoff Vex wins on range (Mistral Bolt 1200 to Ice Shard 725) and Lissandra wins on commit, and it ends with Vex ahead once Shadow Surge scales.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].side all read Skill while content win[4] and win[5] read Lissandra and win[6] read Vex — three rows rendering two different answers, and packet.levelChart agrees with the content layer. phases[6].why also described Lissandra opening every fight under a row the content layer awards to Vex.
audit.why: At 6 Frozen Tomb is a point-and-click lock against a champion whose ult is a missile plus a recast dash, so 6 and first item are Lissandra's. By two items Shadow Surge engages from 3000 range at rank 3 and resets, which Lissandra cannot match.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and phases[5].side -> Lissandra (whys already matched), phases[6].side -> Vex with the why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the fear to Personal Space throughout ('Personal Space (Fear)'). Personal Space is Vex's W — a shield plus nearby damage, 16/15/14/13/12s at 475. The fear comes from the passive, Doom 'n Gloom, which empowers her next basic ability to fear and interrupt dashes. breakdown.cooldowns also held no digit.
audit.why: Riot's text: Personal Space — 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.' Doom 'n Gloom — 'Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark... that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.' That last clause matters enormously here: Lissandra's E is a dash, so clawing near Vex both risks the interrupt and shortens the cooldown on the thing that interrupted you.
audit.corrected: The fear reattributed to Doom 'n Gloom and the shield to Personal Space wherever I rewrote a field; real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns. focus.text still reads 'Vex Personal Space (Fear)' and is flagged rather than half-changed.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags shield-absorbs-burst and nothing on the page told you Personal Space eats your burst window.
audit.why: Personal Space is a 16s shield at rank 1, so a Lissandra combo landed into a fresh shield does far less than the same combo 16 seconds later.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, ahead and spikes[2].text.

audit.why: champ-gender.js lists vex as female; the bodies also failed to explain their own titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected throughout; both bullets rewritten to their titles using Shadow Surge's recast dash and Personal Space's 16s.

NAMING FIX APPLIED CONSISTENTLY: the page called the fear 'Personal Space (Fear)' in focus.text, winCon, loading and three report entries. Personal Space is the W shield; the fear belongs to the passive, Doom 'n Gloom. I moved the token to "Doom 'n Gloom (Fear)" in every field I touched, including focus.text, so the loading screen and the report agree. focus.text is 24 characters after the change and the applier skips strings under 25 characters — if that edit is skipped, focus.text will still read 'Vex Personal Space (Fear)' while the rest of the page reads Doom 'n Gloom, and it should be corrected by hand. Six report entries carried MISGENDER findings, above the two-report sweep limit; I applied pronoun-only swaps rather than rewrites.
